messages:
jamie: Quick readiness check for titan-70b-v2 onboarding — weights are in s3://redwood-models/titan70b/v2/ (sha256: a3f1...), tokenizer is acting weird for some long-prefix cases. Planning max_ctx=65536, KV cache format should be 'packed' but the packer job reported 'separate' on one node. Can folks confirm risky OOM windows and any config fixes? :eyes:
priyanka: I pulled the weights path and verified manifest + checksum. weights path looks good. I also saw a tokenization diff for sequences > 32k where an extra BOS gets prepended when chunking — likely a pretokenizer flag.
cheng: yeah that matches what I saw in local repro. tokenizer.json has "add_bos": true and our chunker was re-introducing it per-chunk. Need to set add_bos=false for the saved tokenizer and then handle proto-level BOS once at request time.
sofia: can you paste the current model config snippet? want to run the config linter quickly.
jamie: here's the trimmed config we uploaded:
```
model_name: titan-70b-v2
max_context: 65536
kv_cache_format: separate
tokenizer:
  file: s3://redwood-models/titan70b/v2/tokenizer.json\  add_bos: true
quantization: none
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/titan70b/v2/weights
```
infra-bot: validation: ERROR kv_cache_format mismatch: runtime expects 'packed' for long-ctx models; found 'separate'. Recommend running tools/kv_pack_converter.py --input s3://redwood-models/titan70b/v2/kv/ --output s3://redwood-models/titan70b/v2/kv_packed/ :warning:
priyanka: ok I'll start the converter job and update the manifest. conversion should take ~18m for this shard set. I'll also set tokenizer.add_bos=false in the tokenizer json and upload a "tokenizer.nomulti.json" variant.
cheng: memory note: even packed KV with 65k for 70B on a single A100-80G is tight. With batch>1 you'll see OOM at kv allocation time. Recommend canary seq_limit=32768 and enable kv-compression + q4_0 quant on the canary. We should also enable prefix caching for repeated prompts.
sofia: +1 to canary lower max. Also add config validation rule: if model_size >= 50b and max_context > 32768 then require explicit autoscale or multi-gpu flag. I'll open a quick PR to the linter.
jamie: thanks. plan: priyanka runs kv pack conversion + tokenizer fix, cheng prepares canary launch config with seq_limit=32768, quant=q4_0, batch_size=1, and sofia will merge the linter rule. I'll follow up once converter completes. Can someone ack code-review ping on my canary helm chart? :thumbsup:
priyanka: ack, will comment on chart in the next 10m.
cheng: ack, I'll validate the runtime flags and try a dry-run on a small shard.
infra-bot: job update: kv_pack_converter job started (job-id: jc-4821). ETA ~18m.
jamie: awesome. Adding a quick note for runbook: if we still see "KV allocation failed" errors post-conversion, fallback plan is to split model onto 2 shards for dedicated testing and re-evaluate memory layout.
priyanka: noted. also will run a tokenization consistency check across 10k sampled prompts after tokenizer update.
sofia: thanks all — I'll keep an eye on PR and run the linter once it's ready. :white_check_mark:
jamie: recording next steps in the onboarding ticket. ping me if you see anything blocking.
infra-bot: kv_pack_converter completed successfully (job-id: jc-4821). output: s3://redwood-models/titan70b/v2/kv_packed/ :party_parrot:
cheng: great, starting the canary with seq_limit=32768, batch=1, quant=q4_0. will post logs if anything OOMs.
priyanka: tokenizer.nomulti.json uploaded and manifest updated.
jamie: perfect, thanks everyone. moving to monitoring phase. :rocket:
